author: Greg Slayden
text: Igor completed my septic system install quickly and without incident. He was very clear on pricing and offered expert advice on other projects that I needed done. I would recommend using him for any excavation needs!

author: Igor Selepina
text: I've known Igor for a very long time and have been using his service for many different projects. Igor is an honest, hardworking individual who's working for his reputation and providing for his family.

author: Igor Reznichenko
text: We hired Igor and his crew to lay down a gravel pad for us. They laid down a tarp and DGA on top. Everything was done neatly and they did a great job cleaning up after themselves. Would use again.

author: Joseph Andrukhov
text: I needed rough grading done for a new construction house. Yuri arrived with a skid steer and gave excellent advice during the walk through to ensure water drains away from the house. He completed the job much faster than I expected and was very efficient with the skid steer. Overall, I had a great experience, and the price was right. I would definitely hire Reliable Outcomes Excavation again.

author: Settle the Score
text: Igor and his crew went above and beyond for us ! We will definitely continue to use them for our projects. Very hard working,honest,knowledgeable 💯
